items.hed: Yordan Alvarez won the American League MVP award Thursday night, capping a .316, 42-home run season that beat out finalists from Tampa Bay and Kansas City
items.insight: ABC13 reports the Astros slugger topped Rays third baseman Junior Caminero and Royals shortstop Bobby Witt Jr. for the award, adding a first MVP trophy to a resume that already includes four All-Star selections, the 2022 World Series title and the 2019 AL Rookie of the Year. Alvarez missed stretches of each of the past two seasons with hand and shoulder injuries, which makes this year's full, healthy, MVP-caliber return a bigger story for the clubhouse than the raw numbers alone.

items.hed: Fred VanVleet's return to the lineup is being credited as a factor in the Rockets' 9-3 start, which continued with a 115-108 win that snapped Golden State's eight-game winning streak
items.insight: The win at Toyota Center moved Houston to 9-3 on the young season and handed the Warriors their first loss in nine games, with Alperen Sengun and Amen Thompson each scoring 19 points. VanVleet spoke with reporters afterward about the team's defensive intensity and ball movement — the kind of steady, unglamorous discipline this desk tracks over highlight-reel stats, a veteran point guard back in the lineup and a locker room buying into the fundamentals.

items.hed: Marvin Harrison Jr. and Will Anderson Jr. both appear on the Texans' Week 11 injury report ahead of Sunday's game at Tennessee
items.insight: Houston's official injury report lists Harrison (hamstring) as a limited participant Wednesday before sitting out Thursday's practice entirely, while edge rusher Will Anderson Jr. (ankle) and Danielle Hunter (hamstring) also appeared on Thursday's report. The Texans play at the Titans this Sunday; final game-status designations typically post Friday.
